controls.name: Every battle but practice counts. Wins, formats and moves are counted from 31 October.
Its Mega form keeps these moves.
Lifetime goals: they never reset. Every level you earn moves the room closer to 100%.
Manual: drag on the arena to move. Your Pokémon only attacks when you press a move.
Manual: move with the left stick. Your Pokémon only attacks when you press a move.
Mix move types: a move your opponent resists does little.
Near the end of the clock comes sudden death: every hit grows stronger.
Sudden death! Every hit grows stronger until the clock runs out.
Your Pokémon fight on their own. Step in to switch, Mega Evolve or call a move.
Your team is locked when the tournament starts.
"Not very effective" moves hit twice as hard.
Ball and bomb moves miss it.
Bug moves 50% stronger at 1/3 HP or less.
Bug, Dark and Ghost moves raise its Speed.
Electric moves raise its Sp. Atk instead.
Electric moves raise its Speed instead.
Fire and Water hits drastically raise its Speed.
Fire moves 50% stronger at 1/3 HP or less.
Fire moves miss it and power up its own Fire moves by 50%.
Fire moves sharply raise its Defense instead.
Grass moves 50% stronger at 1/3 HP or less.
Grass moves raise its Attack instead.
May put the attacker's move back on cooldown.
Moves half as strong at 1/2 HP or less.
Moves of 60 power or less are 50% stronger.
Moves of its own types hit even harder.
Normal moves become Electric and 20% stronger.
Normal moves become Fairy and 20% stronger.
Normal moves become Flying and 20% stronger.
Normal moves become Ice and 20% stronger.
Physical hits lower its Defense and sharply raise its Speed.
Physical moves 50% stronger while it has a status condition.
Takes half damage from Fire; its Water moves are twice as strong.
Takes half damage from Ghost moves; no status conditions.
Takes half damage from contact moves, double from Fire.
Takes half damage from physical moves.
